5 /-! A shortest route cannot pass through a cut point and continue. Equal-length
6 shortest rays from the same source agree if they meet internally. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set Filter BoundedContinuousFunction
11 open scoped Topology ENNReal
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16 
17 include size small_faces in
18 /-- A shortest route cannot pass through a multiple-route target before its final endpoint. -/
19 theorem small_shortest_route_avoids_multiple_locus (f : P.BoundaryCurve) (geodesic : f ∈ P.geodesicCurves)
20     (different : f 0 ≠ f 1) (t : unitInterval) (before : t < 1) :
21     (f t : Space) ∉ P.multipleRouteLocus (f 0) := by
22   rw [P.multiple_routes_iff_fiber (f 0) (f t)]
23   rintro ⟨_, multiple⟩
24   exact multiple (small_geodesic_interior_targets_unique size small_faces f geodesic different t before)
25 
26 include size small_faces in
27 /-- Unique-route targets are dense in the whole boundary, including neighborhoods of edges and vertices. -/
28 theorem small_uniqueTargets_dense (a : frontier P.body) : Dense (P.uniqueTargets a) := by
29   intro b
30   by_cases same : a = b
31   · subst b
32     exact subset_closure (P.geodesicFiber_self a)
33   obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := P.geodesicFiber_nonempty a b
34   have first : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hf.2
35   have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
36   apply mem_closure_iff.mpr
37   intro U openU bU
38   have one_in : (1 : unitInterval) ∈ f ⁻¹' U := by simpa only [mem_preimage, last] using bU
39   obtain ⟨ε, positive, contained⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (openU.preimage f.continuous) 1 one_in
40   obtain ⟨r, after, before⟩ := exists_between (show max (0 : ℝ) (1 - ε) < 1 from
41     max_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith))
42   let t : unitInterval := ⟨r, ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt after).le, before.le⟩
43   have near : t ∈ Metric.ball (1 : unitInterval) ε := by
44     rw [Metric.mem_ball]
45     change dist r (1 : ℝ) < ε
46     rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr before)]
47     have bound := (le_max_right (0 : ℝ) (1 - ε)).trans_lt after
48     linarith
49   refine ⟨f t, contained near, ?_⟩
50   have unique := small_geodesic_interior_targets_unique size small_faces f hf.1
51     (by simpa only [first, last] using same) t before
52   simpa only [first] using unique
53 
54 include size small_faces in
55 /-- The multiple-route locus has empty interior in the actual boundary topology. -/
56 theorem small_multiple_route_locus_interior_empty (a : frontier P.body) :
57     interior {b : frontier P.body | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a} = ∅ := by
58   have dense := small_uniqueTargets_dense size small_faces a
59   rw [P.uniqueTargets_eq_complement_multiple a] at dense
60   exact interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mpr dense
61 
62 include size small_faces in
63 /-- Proper prefixes of every shortest route avoid the vertex-augmented cut set. -/
64 theorem small_geodesic_proper_prefix_outside_cutSet (f : P.BoundaryCurve) (geodesic : f ∈ P.geodesicCurves)
65     (different : f 0 ≠ f 1) (t : unitInterval) (before : t < 1) : f t ∉ P.cutSet (f 0) := by
66   by_cases at_start : t = 0
67   · subst t
68     exact P.source_not_cutSet (f 0)
69   rintro (multiple | vertex)
70   · exact small_shortest_route_avoids_multiple_locus size small_faces f geodesic different t before multiple
71   · obtain ⟨shortest, finite, speed⟩ := P.surfacePathOfCurve_shortest f geodesic
72     exact small_shortest_lipschitz_avoids_vertices size small_faces (P.surfacePathOfCurve f)
73       (fun equal => different (Subtype.ext equal)) shortest finite speed t
74       (lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm at_start)) before vertex.1
75 
76 include size small_faces in
77 /-- A shortest extension through a cut point has that very point as its endpoint. -/
78 theorem small_shortest_extension_of_cut_point (a b c : frontier P.body) (cut : b ∈ P.cutSet a)
79     (extension : c ∈ P.shortestExtensions a b) : c = b := by
80   obtain ⟨f, hf, t, at_t⟩ := P.shortest_extension_path a b c extension
81   have first : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hf.2
82   have last : f 1 = c := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
83   have different : f 0 ≠ f 1 := by
84     intro equal
85     have at_start := P.geodesic_same_endpoints f hf.1 equal t
86     rw [at_t, first] at at_start
87     exact P.source_not_cutSet a (at_start ▸ cut)
88   by_contra cb
89   have before : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 (fun one => cb (by simpa only [one, last] using at_t))
90   have outside := small_geodesic_proper_prefix_outside_cutSet size small_faces f hf.1 different t before
91   rw [first, at_t] at outside
92   exact outside cut
93 
94 include size small_faces in
95 /-- Away from the source, being in the cut set means having no strict shortest extension. -/
96 theorem small_cutSet_iff_terminal (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b) :
97     b ∈ P.cutSet a ↔ ∀ c ∈ P.shortestExtensions a b, c = b := by
98   constructor
99   · exact fun cut c extension => small_shortest_extension_of_cut_point size small_faces a b c cut extension
100   · intro terminal
101     by_contra outside
102     obtain ⟨c, extension, different_c⟩ := small_shortest_extension_outside_cutSet size small_faces a b different outside
103     exact different_c (terminal c extension)
104 
105 include size small_faces in
106 /-- Interior meeting identifies the entire two equal-length rays, including their endpoints. -/
107 theorem small_same_source_geodesics_agree (f g : P.BoundaryCurve)
108     (hf : f ∈ P.geodesicCurves) (hg : g ∈ P.geodesicCurves)
109     (different : f 0 ≠ f 1) (source : f 0 = g 0)
110     (same_length : P.surfaceDist (f 0) (f 1) = P.surfaceDist (g 0) (g 1))
111     (t : unitInterval) (positive : 0 < t) (before : t < 1) (meet : f t = g t) : f = g := by
112   let first := P.surfacePathOfCurve f
113   let second := (P.surfacePathOfCurve g).cast (congrArg Subtype.val source) rfl
114   obtain ⟨first_shortest, first_finite, first_speed⟩ := P.surfacePathOfCurve_shortest f hf
115   obtain ⟨second_shortest, second_finite, second_speed⟩ := P.surfacePathOfCurve_shortest g hg
116   have lengths : first.length = second.length := by
117     apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' first_finite second_finite).mp
118     rw [first.length_eq_surfaceEDist first_shortest]
119     change P.surfaceDist (f 0) (f 1) = (P.surfacePathOfCurve g).length.toReal
120     rw [(P.surfacePathOfCurve g).length_eq_surfaceEDist second_shortest]
121     exact same_length
122   have equal := first.same_source_agree_of_meeting second first_shortest
123     ((P.surfacePathOfCurve g).cast_shortest (congrArg Subtype.val source) rfl second_shortest)
124     first_finite second_finite first_speed second_speed lengths
125     (small_shortest_lipschitz_avoids_vertices size small_faces first
126       (fun same => different (Subtype.ext same)) first_shortest first_finite first_speed)
127     t positive before (congrArg Subtype.val meet)
128   apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
129   intro u
130   exact Subtype.ext (equal u)
131 
132 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
